fields.description: How far back a posting date may reach from the billing day.
fields.label: Max backdate days

fields.description: How far forward a posting date may reach from the billing day.
fields.label: Max future days

fields.description: Pipeline progress a case must show before its placement fee bills: any (upfront), a native attempt stage, or released.
fields.label: Placement fee timing

fields.description: Whether an owner-authorized tuition plan may be split into installments. OFF by default: installments are denied until the owner enables them here.
fields.label: Installments allowed

fields.description: The most installments one enrollment may be split into. The owner's number; nothing in code supplies a schedule length.
fields.label: Maximum installments

fields.description: Days between installment due dates. Set by the owner; use 0 when installments are disabled.
fields.label: Installment interval (days)

fields.description: Why the owner set these terms. Mandatory on every version; part of the audit trail.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Date this version stopped governing new bills. Set by the next version's append; never edited.
fields.label: Superseded on
